snippet.title: STUFFED - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A spooky teddy bear first-person shooter where you defend your owner from waves of her nightmares. Play solo or join your friends in up to 4 player online co-op. Defend your owner's bedroom door and defeat a variety of nightmares in endless waves. Earn points from defeating nightmares and use them to unlock new map areas and weapons.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243200/STUFFED/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
